sectionRef: Approach > Architecture > MCP tool registration pattern
description: The F-006 fix changed tools/init.ts and tools/upsert-task.ts to pass the wrapped strict ZodObject (overviewInitSchema, overviewUpsertTaskSchema) directly as the registerTool inputSchema, while every other MCP tool in the codebase (10 sites in server.ts, plus build/dev-server/sync-now/sync-watch-status tools) still passes asSdkInputSchema(<raw-shape>). This works (the round-trip SDK-boundary test in init-upsert-tools.test.ts confirms unknown-key rejection), but it introduces a stylistic policy-consistency divergence: two parallel patterns for the same operation in adjacent files. Future maintainers reading the codebase have to discover that both work and why. No acceptance criterion is at risk; the diff is green; this is purely a code-uniformity concern.
suggestedFix: Pick one pattern across the package. Either (a) keep asSdkInputSchema(<raw-shape>) everywhere and rely on Zod runtime strictness inside the handler if needed, or (b) refactor asSdkInputSchema to accept a wrapped ZodObject and migrate all 10+ existing call-sites to the wrapped form. Option (a) is the smaller diff. Defer if a future SDK upgrade is likely to change the contract anyway.
